title: Privileged-daemon shellout inventory: .dynsym exec-family imports x %s shell templates map the exec surface before any taint analysis
index_line: T-0053 · EXEC · dynsym exec imports x %s shell templates -> ranked exec-sink candidates, static only · single-source
invariant_violated: A shipped image's privileged daemons are assumed reviewed, but nobody has even enumerated which binaries CAN construct shell commands. The invariant that holds: a binary importing the exec family is a candidate sink, and one also carrying %s-bearing shell templates is exactly where network or config data can become argv.

mechanism.does: walk the extracted rootfs and identify every ELF
read each ELF's .dynsym and DT_NEEDED: flag importers of system/popen/execve/execl*/posix_spawn
extract printable strings from flagged binaries only
match strings containing %s against a shell-token regex (rm/sed/uci/nvram/iptables/tftp/wget/curl/echo/insmod/ifconfig/brctl)
classify taint: which flagged binaries are network-facing (bind/recv imports) or auto-started, and which other daemons reference them
rank candidates and record the false-positive signature: log-format strings, applet symlink farms, compiled-LuCI split constants

source.protocol.value: network- or config-facing daemon that feeds the template slots

guard.escaping.value: quoting/escaping present (or absent) around the substitution slot

encoding.shell.value: metacharacters that survive into the final command line

preconditions.expr: extracted rootfs with intact ELF .dynsym sections

spec.method: dynsym scan across extracted rootfs ELFs for system/popen/execve/execl*/posix_spawn

preconditions.expr: flagged binaries carry %s strings with shell tokens

success: %s templates found in auto-started, non-applet daemons (e.g., 'uci set network.lan.ipaddr=%s', 'nvram set %s=%s', 'iptables %s', 'tftp -gr %s %s &')
caller strings in peer daemons invoking helper shell scripts with %s
failure_like: no templates beyond log/printf formats -> exec surface clean at this depth
false_positive: log-format strings that match the shell-token regex but never reach an exec call (e.g., connection-reuse log messages containing 'URL: %s')
busybox applet symlink farm: one binary counted dozens of times
compiled-LuCI split constants: literal 'io.popen'/'os.execute' greps return 0 on LuaQ bytecode - the name is two constants

hazards: a template proves an exec sink, not taint: the %s source needs call-site RE or runtime confirmation
templates may be dead code paths
non_transfers: static binaries without .dynsym (full-binary string scan instead)

evidence.target: embedded Linux / OpenWrt ELF rootfs static exec-surface analysis (CWE-78 / CWE-88)

provenance.src: GRAFT static ELF exec-surface methodology (CWE-78 / CWE-88)
provenance.author: Abdulrahman Almuhairi
provenance.corroborates: dynsym exec-importer x %s shell-template sweep methodology and false-positive controls

cost.noise: log-format strings and the busybox symlink farm require triage; compiled Lua needs split-constant search
